electrolyte.note: CO2-saturated mixed electrolyte used in the H-shaped electrochemical cell.

cell_configuration.note: Cathodic and anodic compartments separated by a Nafion-117 proton exchange membrane.

reference_electrode.note: Ag/AgCl reference electrode; platinum net counter electrode.

potential_v.note: Ethylene FE of 21.43% corresponds to the approximately -1.2 V vs RHE data point in Figure S11d. Potential verified visually from the supporting figure.

catalyst_architecture.value: Ag nanoparticles supported on BIF-104(Cu) framework nanosheets
catalyst_architecture.source: Supporting Information, Section S3, page 2; Figure S6, page 5
catalyst_architecture.note: Ag@BIF-104NSs(Cu) tandem catalyst prepared using BIF-104(Cu) and AgNO3 under light irradiation.

potential_v.source: Full text, Figure 3d,e; Section 2 (Results and Discussion)
potential_v.note: Maximum FE(C2 products) of 72.85% reported at -1.18 V vs RHE. Verified against Figure 3d,e and accompanying discussion.

current_density_ma_cm2.note: C2-product partial current density. The abstract and Section 2 report a positive magnitude of 243.32 mA/cm2, while Section 4 reports the signed cathodic value of -243.32 mA/cm2.

current_density_type.source: Full text, Section 2 (Results and Discussion); Figure 3d,e
current_density_type.note: Partial current density for combined C2 products, not total current density or ethylene-only partial current density. Reported magnitude is 243.32 mA/cm2.

electrolyte.note: 1 M KOH electrolyte used in a gas-fed flow cell with gas diffusion electrode.
